fact: Burkina Faso's government, with civil society, held online public consultations from 9 September to 8 October 2023 and in-person regional consultations to co-create its 2023-2025 open government action plan, which carries a commitment on digital education.
title: Plan d'action national 2023-2025 du Partenariat pour un gouvernement ouvert
publisher: Gouvernement du Burkina Faso, Open Government Partnership
